The '''Wanderer Space Chest''' was a [[spacer's chest]] produced by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. It was a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] long and cost around 200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Sealed against hard [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] it could be secured with with an [[electronic combo-lock]].<ref name="PP" />
